key_provisions_or_claims: Maps telework, videoconferencing, e-filing and e-file access across Member State justice systems, with wide variation.
Most courts have electronic case management systems (85%) but few use AI (about 12% of courts).
AI projects in justice mainly target anonymisation/pseudonymisation, document management and search.
Machine-readable judgments, ECLI use and metadata remain patchy across Member States.
Cross-border digital exchange in civil and criminal matters is limited; annex summarises 33 Roadmap submissions.
annotation.summary_en: Commission staff working document presenting a 2020 mapping of digitalisation of justice in EU Member States and cross-border cooperation, covering telework, videoconferencing, e-filing, case management, machine-readable judgments and limited AI/blockchain use. Supports the Communication on Digitalisation of justice; includes a synopsis of Roadmap feedback.
